name: free5gc-compose
what_it_is: A Docker Compose deployment of the free5GC open-source 5G standalone core network, providing all 3GPP-defined control-plane and user-plane network functions as containers alongside UERANSIM for gNB/UE simulation. Targets Stage 3 (full protocol) implementation for lab and research use.
protocols: GTP-U (N3 user-plane tunneling via gtp5g kernel module)
measurement: Per-NF Prometheus metrics endpoints (default port 9091, configurable)
Grafana dashboards for visualizing NF-level metrics
Metrics namespace and bind address configurable per NF in config files
configuration: NF configuration files in config/ directory (YAML, one per NF)
ULCL (Uplink Classifier) topology via docker-compose-ulcl.yaml with I-UPF and PSA-UPF
TLS certificates in cert/ directory, configurable per NF
UERANSIM gNB/UE parameters (PLMN, TAC, slice info) in ueransim/ config
Monitoring stack enabled via docker-compose-prometheus.yaml overlay
Build-from-source mode via docker-compose-build.yaml and docker-compose-ulcl-build.yaml
modes: Standard mode: pull pre-built images from Docker Hub and run
Build mode: compile free5GC from local source using docker-compose-build.yaml
ULCL mode: deploy with I-UPF and PSA-UPF for uplink classifier testing (docker-compose-ulcl.yaml)
Monitoring mode: add Prometheus and Grafana overlay (docker-compose-prometheus.yaml)
srsRAN integration: alternative RAN simulator instead of UERANSIM
constraints: Requires GTP5G kernel module v0.9.5 installed on the host; UPF will not function without it
Privileged container execution required for UPF and N3IWF to create tunnel network interfaces
MongoDB versions >4.4 require AVX CPU instruction support; older hardware needs a workaround image
Docker Engine with Compose v2 plugin is mandatory; Compose v1 not supported
ULCL configuration is only tested against the v4.0.0 release tag
notable_absences: No built-in fault injection or chaos tooling
No CI/CD pipeline or automated test suite in the repository
No native support for multi-UPF load balancing outside of ULCL topology
No 4G/EPC interworking (5G SA only; no EPC fallback)
